literature_notes: All five ledger clips (L1–L5) describe a single construct type: full-length human GPR37L1 with eYFP fused to its C-terminus (GPR37L1-eYFP). The topology landmarks place the C-terminus (residue 481) in the intracellular region (420–481), after TM7 (396–419). A C-terminal eYFP fusion is therefore an intracellular label, not an extracellular surface tag, and does not qualify as a surface tag site. The N-terminal truncation constructs described in L3 (Δ25, Δ80, Δ122) are deletions used to probe signal-peptide and N-terminal-fragment function; they are not tag insertions and do not pin any junction. No ledger clip describes a tag at the mature N-terminus (residue 26, extracellular), in any extracellular loop (ECL1 190–204, ECL2 270–310, ECL3 382–395), or in the large N-terminal extracellular domain (26–129). Accordingly, zero extracellular surface tag sites are reported.

literature_other_positions.note: eYFP fused to the C-terminus of full-length GPR37L1; the C-terminus (residue 481) lies in the intracellular region (420–481) after TM7, making this an intracellular fluorescent-protein fusion, not an extracellular surface tag.
